summary.text: Abigail W. Griffin, a Republican, represents House District 34 (Glenburn, Kenduskeag and Levant, Penobscot County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Levant. The House profile lists membership on the Health and Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired teacher as the occupation and a B.S. in education (1977).
Listed affiliations include community volunteer work.
It says Griffin is married, to James, with five children and six grandchildren.
